channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Who has profited most from the war on Iran?
item.description: Defence contractors, energy companies and investment banks saw profits soar as war and uncertainty upended markets.

item.title: Iran war day 119: Israel hits Lebanon as IAEA says it will return to Iran
item.description: Israeli and Lebanese delegations will continue their talks on Friday.

item.title: Egypt coach offers support for Iranian team before crucial World Cup match
item.description: Hossam Hassan invokes FIFA's 'respect and fair play' rules amid US restrictions on Iran, whom Egypt face in Seattle.

item.title: Oil prices ease after spiking over halt to Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan
item.description: Brent crude subsides after attack in waterway prompted jump in prices.

item.title: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan after cargo ship attacked
item.description: The ship was reportedly struck by an "unknown projectile" near Oman but no casualties were reported.

item.title: Trump asks Congress for billions for Iran war, after tension with Republicans
item.description: But the budget faces an uphill battle as the president spars with some members of his own party over the issue.

item.title: Families lay flowers on barbed wire barricade on anniversary of deadly Kenya protests
item.description: Protesters demand justice for the dozens killed during the 2024 demonstrations and last year's anniversary protests.

item.title: Oil price falls back to pre-Iran war levels
item.description: Signs that traffic through the key Strait of Hormuz shipping route is gradually resuming has helped to push the oil price down.

item.title: Philippines bans video game played by alleged high school shooter
item.description: The rare school shooting that left three students killed and 20 others injured has shocked the country.

item.title: Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary
item.description: Brad Lander unseats Dan Goldman in a race that laid bare the city's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war.
